title: Kyrie (de Marle, Missa O gente brunette)
desc: Nicolas de Marle, Missa O gente brunette, Kyrie, 1568. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0003_1); edited by Vincent Besson, David Fiala, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
